topic: Cleanrooms are 10,000x Cleaner Than Hospital Surgery Rooms
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know Chip Cleanrooms Beat Surgery Rooms? 🧪

Here is the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 A single speck of human dead skin or dust can bridge microscopic transistor paths. Air in chip cleanrooms is filtered to under 10 particles per cubic meter.
